title: docs(skills): checklist-author counts six sweep angles
body:
Part of #22195

Clause-②: no

## What changes

`.claude/skills/checklist-author/SKILL.md` gets its three angle-count words and nothing else, five to six:

- line 5, frontmatter `description`: `five-angle capability sweep` becomes `six-angle capability sweep`
- line 55, scale guide: "5 个 hunter" becomes "6 个 hunter"
- line 59, the no-subagent fallback: "五个角度" becomes "六个角度"

The count follows #22207, which adds row 6 ("Surface kinds vs the one design system") to the angle table in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/SWEEP.md` and moves that file's own count words. That PR carries the card's landing line. This one is Part of the card and leaves it open. The two are separate PRs because this file is under `.claude/**` (Tier S) and #22207's file is not governed, and a mixed diff would be governed as a whole.

Nothing else in the skill moves. "六步流程" counts the six steps of "How to run it", not the angles, and is unchanged. The file is still 62 lines, its ceiling, and no line was rewrapped.

The edits cite no issue number: `grep -c -E '#[0-9]{3,}'` on the file reads 0.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么

`.claude/skills/checklist-author/SKILL.md` 里三处数角度的词由「五」改「六」:描述行 `five-angle` 改为 `six-angle`,规模指引「5 个 hunter」改为「6 个 hunter」,无子代理退化段「五个角度」改为「六个角度」。其余一字未动,文件仍为 62 行。

### 为什么改

您批准(「同意,立卡」)给 coverage sweep 加一个角度:「界面种类 对 唯一的设计系统」,专门找功能项都通过、却绕开设计系统的界面(RecordPickerDialog 那一类)。新角度那一行在 #22207 落到 `SWEEP.md`。技能若仍写「五个角度」,AI 按技能跑 sweep 会少派一个 hunter。给 AI 读的文档把数量写错,本身就是产品缺陷。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)

风险很低:只改三个计数词,不涉及代码、门禁或发布面。唯一的顺序依赖:若本 PR 先于 #22207 落地,会短暂出现技能写六个角度、表里只有五行的不一致,所以应排在 #22207 之后。回滚:revert 这一个提交即可。
